findings: PumpAPI txSigner is complete enough in this bounded sample to build a deterministic signer-to-local-create-signatures index from installation onward.
Repeated signers appeared during only 73 seconds, proving the forward index has immediate observational value.
For fresh Pump creates, Jupiter dev exactly duplicated PumpAPI txSigner in all 50 samples; it was not an independent creator attribution source.
creatorFeeAddress is not universal and must not replace txSigner.
Jupiter devMints/devMigrations remain provider-derived and ambiguous; values can be very large and are not accompanied by signatures or methodology.
No source proves that txSigner is a human owner, sole controller, malicious actor, or the person responsible for future behavior.
